frames.visible_job: Attach one dorsal fin and one lower fin, then place one eye near the fish's right-facing nose.

frames.visible_job: Add exactly three floor pebbles and a rooted two-leaf plant, then tint its leaves muted green.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop has a shallow top oval joined to the round glass sides and a short flat base. These fixed landmarks make the next waterline easy to place without erasing the vessel.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I examined all six saved JPGs in order, including the colored finish. The oval rim and base stay registered; one fish keeps a right-facing nose and a left forked tail, then gains one eye and two fins. Exactly three pebbles and two attached plant leaves appear before the finish. No temporary guides or unexplained structural removals occur; the paper grain and pencil strokes remain visible.
